Every source URL uses the reserved .invalid TLD, which can never resolve, and
capturedAt is the 1970 sentinel meaning 'never actually observed'. The scout
marks any opportunity built on these as PLACEHOLDER EVIDENCE.
Replace each entry with something you observed yourself: real URL, real
capture timestamp, and metrics you can defend. The scout ranks signals; it
never authors them, so an unreplaced placeholder cannot pass as trend data.
